title: Can Hindsight Critics Guide Delayed Actors?
abstract: arXiv:2611.11863v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sensory delays create temporal misalignments between the state of the environment and the observations available to an agent, turning Markovian control problems into partially observable ones. In this work, we inquire whether such misalignments can be mitigated during training by using hindsight to recover aligned state-action transitions. We introduce Hindsight Critics, an asymmetric extension of the Soft Actor-Critic for reinforcement learning under partial observability. The critics are trained on hindsight-aligned transitions whereas the actor learns from the resulting privileged value estimates despite only having access to delayed observations. Comparisons against delay-aware and unaware baselines on the DelayBench suite show that Hindsight Critics can partially compensate for observation delays without requiring modifications to the agent's observations during deployment.

translated_title: 后见评论家能否引导延迟行动者？
translated_abstract: 感知延迟会造成环境状态与智能体可用观测之间的时间错位，从而将马尔可夫控制问题转变为部分可观测问题。在本研究中，我们探究这种错位能否在训练期间通过事后方法恢复对齐的状态-动作转移来加以缓解。我们提出了Hindsight Critics，这是柔性演员-评论家算法在部分可观测性下强化学习的一种非对称扩展。评论家在事后对齐的转移上训练，而行动者尽管只能获取延迟的观测，却能从由此产生的特权价值估计中学习。在DelayBench基准套件上与延迟感知和延迟无感知基线的比较表明，Hindsight Critics能够部分补偿观测延迟，且无需在部署阶段修改智能体的观测。
tldr: 提出Hindsight Critics方法，利用事后对齐的状态-动作转移训练评论家并生成特权价值估计来指导仅能获得延迟观测的行动者，在无需修改部署阶段观测的情况下部分补偿了感知延迟。
en_tdlr: Hindsight Critics, an asymmetric extension of Soft Actor-Critic, trains critics on hindsight-aligned transitions to provide privileged value estimates guiding delayed actors, partially compensating for observation delays without modifying agent observations at deployment.
